gaps.description: The fix reddens ten pre-existing tests that are green at the base. tests/test_e2e_lifecycle.py:55 builds the cmd_add Namespace with criteria="All tests pass|No errors" (a pipe string, the old wire format); on the head _parse_list_flag refuses it and sys.exit(1)s inside every test's first cmd_add call. Measured: base a95f645 `python3 -m pytest tests/test_e2e_lifecycle.py` = 10 passed, exit 0; head 042c1cc = 10 failed, exit 1, every failure at amauta.py _refuse_list_flag with raw='All tests pass|No errors'. The lane reported the delta as test_e2e_lifecycle x6 and called it 'not attributed'; it is x10 and it is caused by the change (a fixture still emitting the pipe format). Fix: tests/test_e2e_lifecycle.py:55 -> criteria=json.dumps(["All tests pass", "No errors"]) (or the list serialised the same way), and add criteria_file/deliverables_file/checklist_file/refs_file=None to the Namespace if the test is to mirror argparse. Not a real-path break: every production caller (gsd-tools.cjs x2, daemon _build_args, e2e-advanced.test.cjs) emits JSON; hence gaps-found, not fail.

installed_copy: ~/.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs:1865 still has criteria.join(' | '); expected until bin/install.js runs after merge. Until then the running harness's plan-to-tasks still emits the pipe format and, once this branch's amauta.py is what it shells to, will be refused loudly rather than cut silently.

mirror_lag: through the private daemon, /api/exec update was not reflected in the sqlite mirror until the next daemon start (TK-0005 updated to ['p | q'] via /api/exec; mirror still held the add-time value at shutdown; TK-0001/TK-0003 updated in an earlier session were current after restart). Pre-existing behaviour of the /api/exec path, not this PR's.
docstring_stale: amauta.py _parse_list_flags docstring says 'Runs BEFORE the store is loaded or locked'; since 35c1549 it runs inside _file_lock (before load()). Cosmetic.

concatenated_pair: ST-0182 and ST-0183 (the 2 CONCATENATED of the 497) each hold two criteria joined by a literal '\n- ' markdown separator; a delimiter-only repair of those two is possible through the new `update --criteria '[...]'` path. The 495 TRUNCATED cannot be restored byte-exactly by any automated migration because split('|') also strip()ped each fragment, so the whitespace around every cut is gone; a heuristic re-join is what TK-2322's per-item ledger does.

brief_ambient_env: the shell carries GSD_POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://gsd:gsd@127.0.0.1:5433/gsd_amauta (the live mirror). amauta.py reads it for its memory DSN and infra_detect gives it priority 1; a private AMAUTA_DATA_DIR alone does not isolate a run. Every validator command after discovery ran with it unset; cmd_add/cmd_update/cmd_show have no _mem_log_event/_pg_conn call, so the earlier runs that inherited it wrote nothing to PG.
